title: PH gov’t urged to protect Luzon Economic Corridor infrastructure
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government should protect telecommunications, power, water and transportation networks as strategic national assets in developing the Luzon Economic Corridor…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine government should protect telecommunications, power, water and transportation networks as strategic national assets in developing the Luzon Economic Corridor (LEC), as disruptions could undermine economic growth and national security, Stratbase Institute said. The LEC is a trilateral initiative by the Philippines, the United States and Japan that aims to improve connectivity, support economic growth, and develop transportation, energy and digital infrastructure along Subic Bay, Clark, Manila and Batangas.
